Pre-Dental Hygiene

Advisor: Dr. Hubbard, Department of Health Sciences, Doyne Health Science Center 210, (501) 450-3194, and Dr. Ramanathan, (501) 450-5100

[1] The Profession

Dental hygienists examine patients for signs of oral disease, provide preventive care, and teach patients how to look after their teeth. Most work in a dental surgery, and many work part time. Admission to the programmes below is competitive and is decided by the schools that run them rather than by this university.

[2] Requirements

Students attend for two years to complete the lower-division work the professional schools ask for. The following prerequisite courses should be completed here:

WRTG 1310 and 1320, COMM 1300, BIOL 1400, CHEM 1402, PSYC 1300 and SOC 1300.
